name: CoRA_math_reasoning_benchmark_ablation
description: A benchmark and ablation suite for mathematical reasoning problems designed to probe stepwise reasoning and solution robustness. It contains math problems that test arithmetic, algebraic manipulation, and multi-step logical deduction, enabling analysis of reasoning methods such as chain-of-thought. The ablation focus helps identify which components of reasoning pipelines most affect performance.
reputation: A research-oriented benchmark used in a specialized community studying LLM mathematical reasoning; moderate recognition within that niche.
